contained-t-check.desc: Nothing inside a `t` module may call a free function from our crate.

exceptions.exception: The free function is in the same `t` module
We don't own the free function (e.g. it's from a dependency or std)

contained-t-check.rationale: Since impls must be in a `t` module, it keeps methods scoped to easy helper functions. The preference is for larger functionality to be in free functions elsewhere in the codebase.
